title: Post index: hotkey nav, brand column, filter tabs, a featured row with a clay pixel tile and 6-8 hairline rows with icon, date, title and read time
use: The front page of a developer blog or changelog: the list of posts. rows sets how many rows show (6-8); each row's date, title and read time are slots. The mascot slot stays empty or holds your own art.

glyph.note: pixel glyph of the featured tile

glyph_offset.note: where the row icons start in the glyph list

mascot.note: the site's mascot, small (36 x 36); your own art

feature_title.default: Teaching a test harness to explain its own failures
